entities.summary: Edward Ferdinand Jacob Lindberg was an American Olympic athlete, winner of the gold medal in 4 × 400 m relay at the 1912 Summer Olympics in Stockholm, Sweden. He was born in Cherokee, Iowa and died in Highland Park, Illinois.
